ndvi_a_40m.encoding: NDVI*10000, -32768 = no clear view on both dates (40 m)

ndvi_b_40m.encoding: NDVI*10000, -32768 = no clear view on both dates (40 m)

optical.source: NASA HLS S30 v2.0 (Sentinel-2 surface reflectance harmonized), DOI 10.5067/HLS/HLSS30.002

sensitivity_north_tile.note: Adding tile 36SYG (21 Oct baseline) raised coverage to 86% but created an NDVI seam; excluded.

optical.method: NDVI=(B8A-B04)/(B8A+B04); Fmask cloud/adjacent/shadow/snow excluded; average-resampled to the NISAR 20 m grid; per-object median over pixels clear on both dates

weather.source: NASA POWER daily point, PRECTOTCORR (mm/day), community AG
